response.sql: WITH player_averages AS (SELECT bp.player_id, p.bats, AVG(bp."double") AS avg_doubles FROM batting_postseason AS bp JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = bp.player_id GROUP BY bp.player_id, p.bats), indexed AS (SELECT player_id, bats, avg_doubles, avg_doubles / NULLIF((SELECT AVG(avg_doubles) FROM player_averages), 0) AS relative_index FROM player_averages), gaps AS (SELECT player_id, bats, avg_doubles, relative_index, relative_index - AVG(relative_index) OVER (PARTITION BY bats) AS gap FROM indexed) SELECT player_id, bats, avg_doubles, relative_index, gap FROM gaps ORDER BY gap IS NULL, gap DESC, player_id LIMIT 10;
